Downard family · Person

Clace Sabey

1895–1989

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
Clace Sabey, Clace Bradley, Clace Downard, Clace Sabey Bradley Downard
Born
October 28, 1895 · Vernal, Utah
Died
January 22, 1989 · Vernal, Utah
Burial
January 24, 1989 · Vernal Memorial Park, Vernal, Utah

Raised five children across two marriages, cared for neighborhood children and was remembered with affection by grandson Robert T. Downard. The 1956–59 court notices document an alimony dispute.

Clace used Sabey, Bradley and Downard at different stages of her life. She married Marshall “Mack” Bradley in 1917 and Walter Downard in 1921. Oaka, Barbara and Mary Jane Bradley were Walter’s stepchildren.
